title: Backups & Recovery
lede: Two layers protect your work: project backups you take, and automatic reconciliation on startup.
body:
At a glance
  • Project backups (optionally with audio).
  • Disk-based project recovery.
  • Startup reconciliation.

Backups

Snapshot a project and restore it later. See Backups for the in-app flow.

Recovery & reconciliation

Studio can rebuild project state from disk and reconciles state on startup so a crash doesn't lose validated work. See Artifacts, Reuse & Recovery.
